cards.name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
cards.oracle_text:
Menace
Creatures you control have wither. (They deal damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.)
Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, if its toughness was less than 1, draw a card.

cards.name: Reins of Power
cards.oracle_text: Untap all creatures you control and all creatures target opponent controls. You and that opponent each gain control of all creatures the other controls until end of turn. Those creatures gain haste until end of turn.

rulings.comment: It is perfectly legal for either or both players to have zero creatures. They give control of all their zero creatures as instructed.
You only untap creatures controlled by you and the targeted opponent, not all creatures.
Use the toughness of the creature as it last existed on the battlefield to determine whether or not Massacre Girl's ability triggers.

Wither applies to any damage dealt to creatures by creatures you control. This includes combat damage as well as anything that causes creatures you control to deal noncombat damage, such as Incinerator of the Guilty's reflexive triggered ability or the effect of Hard-Hitting Question.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
